newsitem.title: USA: Former Astra USA consultant indicted.
newsitem.headline: Former Astra USA consultant indicted.

text.p: A federal grand jury indicted a former consultant with Astra USA Inc, charging him with conspiring with the former chief executive to defraud more than $1 million from the drug company.

Lars Magnusson, a consultant in 1988 and 1989 and again in 1996, allegedly conspired with former Astra USA Chief Executive Lars Bildman to defraud the company by instructing contractors to do work for Bildman at the company's expense, the U.S. Attorney's office in Massachusetts said.
Magnusson, whose contract with Astra called for pay of $1,900 a day, also allegedly helped Bildman remove and destroy documents and caused other people not to cooperate with investigators.
He was arrested Thursday at his home in Auburn, Maine, the U.S. Attorney's office said.

Bildman, who was fired by the U.S. unit of the Swedish pharmaceutical giant last year following allegations he sexually abused some female employees, has pled not guilty in a U.S. District Court to charges of fraud, filing false tax statements, and traveling across state lines to engage in prostitution.
A federal investigation into Astra is continuing, the U.S. Attorney's office said.
